SEASON.exampleZh: 春天是我最喜歡的季節。

MANUAL.example: Reading the manual is necessary before using the machine.
MANUAL.exampleZh: 在使用機器之前閱讀手冊是必要的。

STAR.example: Look at the stars in the sky.

BACKGROUND.example: My educational background has prepared me for this role.
BACKGROUND.exampleZh: 我的教育背景讓我為這個角色做好了準備。

INGREDIENT.example: I purchased fresh vegetable ingredients at the organic market yesterday.
INGREDIENT.exampleZh: 我昨天在有機市集購買了新鮮的蔬菜食材原料。

TITLE.example: The title of this book is written on the cover.
TITLE.exampleZh: title 是「書名、標題」，會寫在封面上 (cover)。

TECHNIQUE.example: A new technique has been discovered.
TECHNIQUE.exampleZh: 一項新技巧已經被發現了。

CHANNEL.example: My father watched the evening sports channel yesterday after dinner.
CHANNEL.exampleZh: 我父親昨天晚餐後看了晚間體育頻道。

AMOUNT.example: The cashier scanned the barcode and told me the total amount to pay.
AMOUNT.exampleZh: amount 是「金額、數量」，收銀員刷條碼後會告訴顧客總金額。

STAGE.meaning: 演員走到舞台上並開始唱歌
STAGE.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「演員走到舞台上並開始唱歌」。

THIRSTY.example: I am so thirsty after the run.

ORGANIZE.example: The meeting has been organized for tomorrow.
ORGANIZE.exampleZh: 會議已經安排在明天舉行。

EARLY.example: I get up early on weekdays.

TAKES.example: Mr. Lin does not work on weekends. He always takes his family to the park on Saturdays.
TAKES.exampleZh: 主詞 He 是單數第三人稱，頻率副詞 always 後的現在簡單式動詞字尾加 -s 寫作 takes。

DISCUSS.exampleZh: 我們明天討論這個計畫。

PRACTICE.example: They practiced conversational English for two hours last night.
PRACTICE.exampleZh: 他們昨晚練習了兩小時的日常英語會話。

CLUB.example: To join the tennis club, you need to sign your name on this paper.
CLUB.exampleZh: club 是「社團、俱樂部」，加入網球社需要簽名。

WIN.example: The team won first prize in the competition.
WIN.exampleZh: 該團隊在競賽中贏得了首獎。

GAME.example: Do you want to play a game?

FASTER.example: The subway is faster than the bus.
FASTER.exampleZh: 有 than 用比較級：fast → faster。

WINS.meaning: 這題測試第一類條件句
WINS.example: If our team wins this match, they will go to the finals.
WINS.exampleZh: 這題測試第一類條件句。

EXCHANGE.example: I want to exchange this shirt for a larger one.
EXCHANGE.exampleZh: 我想把這件襯衫換成大一點的。

SWEATER.example: You need a thick sweater if you travel to Canada in December.
SWEATER.exampleZh: 十二月的加拿大很冷，需要厚毛衣 (sweater)。

CONDITION.example: The device is in perfect condition.

ASSIST.example: The staff is always ready to assist you.
ASSIST.exampleZh: 工作人員隨時準備為您提供協助。

MADE.example: It is high time we made a decision.
MADE.exampleZh: It is (high) time + 主詞 + 過去式，表示「早該做某事了」。

TEE.meaning: 制約產能之卡脖子瓶頸
TEE.exampleZh: 制約產能之卡脖子瓶頸。

STOCK.example: This item is out of stock.

COFFEE.example: I drink coffee in the morning.

LIGHT.example: Can you turn on the light? It's getting dark in here.
LIGHT.exampleZh: 變暗 (getting dark) 時需要開燈 (light)。

SAFETY.example: For safety reasons, please wear your helmet.
SAFETY.exampleZh: 為了安全起見，請戴上你的安全帽。

LEARN.example: He learned a lot from his supervisor.
LEARN.exampleZh: 他從主管身上學到了很多。

INTERNET.example: I use the internet every day.

CONNECTION.example: The internet connection is very slow here.

CABLE.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「線纜、電線」。

PRESS.example: If you press the red button, the machine will shut down immediately.
PRESS.exampleZh: 第一類條件句：If 條件子句用現在式代替未來式，主要子句用未來式 (will shut down)，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 press。

BUTTON.meaning: 按下這個紅色的按鈕來打開電視
BUTTON.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「按下這個紅色的按鈕來打開電視」。

CUT.example: The firm decided to cut administrative expenses.
CUT.exampleZh: 該公司決定削減行政開支。

DRESS.exampleZh: 她穿著一件紅色的洋裝。

MOVE.example: The office will move to the fourth floor.

SOFA.example: We bought a new sofa for the living room because the old one was uncomfortable.
SOFA.exampleZh: sofa 是沙發，與「不舒服 (uncomfortable)」及「客廳 (living room)」的情境最搭。

CHARITY.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「慈善機構」。

BEACH.example: The beach is crowded in summer.

IC.meaning: 彼此相應給予或協助的互惠關係
IC.exampleZh: 彼此相應給予或協助的互惠關係。

MATERIAL.example: All materials have been prepared for the workshop.
MATERIAL.exampleZh: 工作坊的所有材料都已經準備好了。

PROVIDE.example: The company provides health insurance for all employees.
PROVIDE.exampleZh: 公司為所有員工提供健康保險。

WORKSHOP.exampleZh: 我們參加了寫作工作坊。

SIGHTSEEING.example: Going sightseeing is my favorite part of traveling.
SIGHTSEEING.exampleZh: 去觀光是我旅行中最喜歡的部分。

TELL.example: Can you tell me the way to the station?
TELL.exampleZh: 你可以告訴我去車站的路嗎？

ANTIQUE.meaning: 因年代而受收藏的古物
ANTIQUE.example: The dealer described the chair as an antique.

DECK.example: Return the card to the deck.

LANDMARK.example: The chimney is a useful landmark when you return from the beach.
LANDMARK.exampleZh: 從海灘回來時，煙囪是實用的地標。

PROMOTION.example: He got a promotion last month.

DELIVERY.example: Delivery is free for orders over $50.

PAYMENT.example: Payment is due on the first.

WORKING.example: We look forward to working with you.
WORKING.exampleZh: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後接 V-ing。

CATALOG.example: Please send me your new catalog.
CATALOG.exampleZh: 請寄你們的新型錄給我。

EXPRESS.example: Many customers have expressed their satisfaction.
EXPRESS.exampleZh: 許多顧客已經表達了他們的滿意。

GETTING.example:
A: I can't seem to focus during the day. 
B: You should consider getting more sleep to avoid chronic fatigue.

ACCIDENT.example: He had a car accident yesterday.

PILOT.example: He is the most experienced pilot in the company.
PILOT.exampleZh: 他是公司裡最有經驗的飛行員。

PHOTOGRAPHY.example: She took a course in digital photography.
PHOTOGRAPHY.exampleZh: 她上了一門數位攝影課程。

LECTURE.example: The professor gave an interesting lecture on modern history yesterday.
LECTURE.exampleZh: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。

WEBSITE.example: Our company launched a new official website two months ago.
WEBSITE.exampleZh: 我們公司兩個月前推出了全新的官方網站。

POPULAR.example: If the itinerary is popular, we will offer it again.
POPULAR.exampleZh: 如果這個行程受歡迎，我們將會再次提供。

CROWDED.example: The train is crowded in the morning.

REACH.example: You can reach me by email during office hours.
REACH.exampleZh: 上班時間您可以透過電子郵件與我聯繫。

DEGREES.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「度數（溫度）」。

CONTINUE.example: The discussion will continue after lunch.

ACTIVITY.example: The company organized an outdoor activity for all employees last week.
ACTIVITY.exampleZh: 公司上週為全體員工舉辦了一場戶外活動。

PUBLIC.example: The public transportation in this big city is very convenient and cheap.
PUBLIC.exampleZh: 句意為「這座大城市的『大眾』運輸非常方便且便宜」。

DEVICE.example: This device is easy to use.

COUNTER.example: Pick up your drink at the counter.

SUPERVISOR.example: The supervisor who trained me expects everyone to work efficiently.
SUPERVISOR.exampleZh: 培訓我的主管期望每個人都能有效率地工作。

SERVE.example: Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
SERVE.exampleZh: 早餐於七點至十點供應。

RECOGNIZE.example: I didn't recognize you in that hat.
RECOGNIZE.exampleZh: 你戴那頂帽子我都認不出你來了。

SYSTEM.example: The new computer system is fast.

MAINTENANCE.example: The elevator is closed for maintenance.

HOSPITAL.example: She works at the city hospital.

DOING.example:
A: How do you handle stress? 
B: I practice doing deep breathing exercises every morning.

COUNTRY.exampleZh: 台灣是一個美麗的國家。

IMPORTANT.example: Water is important for our health.
IMPORTANT.exampleZh: 水對我們的健康很重要。

INSTALL.example: I need to install this software.

FORBIDDEN.example: Taking photos in the museum is forbidden.

BOARD.example: 「你有看到board上的通知嗎？」空格中應填入：
BOARD.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「【詞彙】board」的實際運用。

TURNED.example: I turned at the crossroad and went straight for two blocks.
TURNED.exampleZh: 後半句的 went straight 是過去式，表示這是發生在過去的動作，前半句也用過去式 turned。

RESERVATION.meaning: 預先訂妥座位或房間的安排
RESERVATION.example: Our reservation is for six thirty.

RESIDENT.example: The residents who live here are happy with the new rules.
RESIDENT.exampleZh: 住在這兒的居民對新規定感到很滿意。

ARTICLE.example: She wrote an article about health.
ARTICLE.exampleZh: 她寫了一篇關於健康的文章。

STRESS.example: The manager stressed the importance of teamwork.
STRESS.exampleZh: 經理強調了團隊合作的重要性。

STRICTLY.example: The use of artificial food coloring is strictly prohibited in organic products.
STRICTLY.exampleZh: 句意為「有機產品中嚴格禁止使用人工食用色素」。

NECESSARY.example: It has become necessary to update our systems.
NECESSARY.exampleZh: 更新我們的系統已經變得必要了。

LAPTOP.example: I brought my laptop to the meeting.

HAPPY.example: I am happy to see you.

NEIGHBORHOOD.example: We were exploring the neighborhood when we found this cafe.
NEIGHBORHOOD.exampleZh: 我們在探索這個社區時發現了這家咖啡館。

KITCHEN.example: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.

PLUMBER.example: Call a plumber to fix the leak.

UTILITIES.example: The rent includes all basic utilities.

PRESCRIPTION.example: You need a prescription for antibiotics.

EMERGENCY.example: In case of emergency, please call 119.

EFFECT.example: The new policy will take effect next month.

OPERATOR.example: The operator will transfer your call shortly.
OPERATOR.exampleZh: 接線生稍後會幫您轉接電話。

HEAVILY.example: Climate Report: The continuous desertification of arable land forces rural communities to flee. Without immediate agricultural interventions, the region will face a massive humanitarian crisis as millions of people become heavily dependent on international food aid. Q: Which word best fills in the blank?
HEAVILY.exampleZh: 正確答案是 C (嚴重地 / 高度地)。

PROPOSAL.exampleZh: 董事會接受了我們的提案。

REDUCED.example: The valley lay below us, its cottages reduced to small pale marks.
REDUCED.exampleZh: 獨立結構 cottages reduced to...，在遠視中被縮成小點。

UPGRADE.example: You can upgrade to first class for free.
UPGRADE.exampleZh: 你可以免費升等至頭等艙。

CONSIDER.example: We are considering several different vendors.
CONSIDER.exampleZh: 我們正在考慮幾家不同的供應商。

RENEW.example: Please renew your contract before May.

BENEFITS.example: Employees are satisfied with the excellent health benefits provided by the company.
BENEFITS.exampleZh: 此語境充分體現了「福利」的實際運用。

RESPONSIBLE.example: If he is responsible, the project will succeed.
RESPONSIBLE.exampleZh: 如果他是負責任的，專案就會成功。

SUCCESSFUL.example: The event was successfully organized by the team.
SUCCESSFUL.exampleZh: 這次活動已由團隊成功舉辦。

EXCITING.example: We watched an exciting baseball game at the stadium last night.
EXCITING.exampleZh: 我們昨晚在體育場看了一場令人興奮的棒球賽。

PARTICIPATE.example: I decided to participate in the workshop that the company hosted.
PARTICIPATE.exampleZh: 我決定參加公司舉辦的工作坊。

TRAINING.exampleZh: 新進員工必須參加培訓。

EVALUATE.example: We need to evaluate the results.

ABSENT.example: He was absent from school yesterday.

BUILD.example: They built a brand new facility outside the city.
BUILD.exampleZh: 他們在城外興建了一座全新的設施。

COUNTRYSIDE.example: The countryside is quieter than the city.

IMPROVE.example: Customer service has been improved recently.
IMPROVE.exampleZh: 客戶服務最近已經得到改善。

HOST.example: The club has hosted three events this year.
HOST.exampleZh: 這個社團今年已經主辦了三場活動。

SUBJECT.example: What is your favorite subject at school? I really like history and math.
SUBJECT.exampleZh: subject 是「科目」，歷史 (history) 和數學 (math) 都是學校科目。

HEATER.example: I turned on the heater because my bedroom was freezing.
HEATER.exampleZh: heater 是「暖氣機」，房間極冷 (freezing) 時需要開暖氣。

ADVANCE.exampleZh: 此例句展示了「事先；提前」。

BOY.example: The boy is playing in the park.
BOY.exampleZh: 那個男孩正在公園裡玩。

DRAW.meaning: 雙方得分相同的平手結果
DRAW.example: The match ended in a draw.

WRAP.example: Let us wrap up today's discussion.

PERSONNEL.exampleZh: 只有授權人員可以進入。

FALL.example: Prices are expected to fall next month.
FALL.exampleZh: 預計價格下個月會下跌。

FOLDER.example: Save the file in this folder.
FOLDER.exampleZh: 把檔案存在這個資料夾。

GREEN.example: The trees are green in spring.

RIVER.example: You have to pay to get on the ferry to get across the river.
RIVER.exampleZh: river 是「河流」，渡輪 (ferry) 是用來渡河的交通工具。

FEATURE.example: This camera has many amazing features.
FEATURE.exampleZh: 這台相機有許多令人驚豔的特色。

REPLACE.example: The old machine was replaced last week.

BELONGINGS.example: Make sure you have all your personal belongings.
BELONGINGS.exampleZh: 請確保您帶齊了所有個人隨身物品。

WRITE.example: She wrote a detailed summary of the event.
WRITE.exampleZh: 她寫了一份詳盡的活動摘要。

SHADOW.example: The tree casts a long shadow on the grass.
SHADOW.exampleZh: 樹在草地上投下了長長的影子。

SHOULDER.example: He tapped me on the shoulder.

PLANT.example: I water the plant every day.

CORNER.example: The bank is on the corner.

RESCHEDULE.example: We need to reschedule the meeting for tomorrow.
RESCHEDULE.exampleZh: 我們需要將會議重新安排到明天。

VERIFICATION.example: Independent verification is needed before publication.

CENTER.example: The office is in the city center.

FRIDGE.example: Put the milk in the fridge.

ADD.example: Add your signature at the bottom of the page.
ADD.exampleZh: 在頁面底端加上您的簽名。

DONATION.example: The donation included a box of postcards.

WORSE.example: The hurricane in the south was much worse than the news predicted.
WORSE.exampleZh: than 提示需要比較級，bad 的比較級為不規則變化 worse。

BECOME.exampleZh: 他成為了一名成功的經理。

COOL.example: A: Is it warm outside right now? B: No, it is very cool. You need a jacket.

SUSPEND.example: Due to the unexpected power outage, the factory had suspended all production lines.
SUSPEND.exampleZh: 由於無預警停電，工廠已經暫停了所有生產線。

INCONVENIENCE.example: They apologized for the inconvenience they had caused.
INCONVENIENCE.exampleZh: 他們為所造成的不便道歉。

SITUATION.example: I have never been in this kind of situation before.
SITUATION.exampleZh: 我以前從未經歷過這種情況。

OFFICIALLY.example: If they had officially apologized then, the PR crisis wouldn't have worsened.
OFFICIALLY.exampleZh: 如果他們當時正式道歉，這場公關危機就不會惡化了。

REASONABLE.example: We chose a hotel that offers a reasonable price.
REASONABLE.exampleZh: 我們選擇了一家提供合理價格的飯店。

SIGNIFICANTLY.example: Profits have increased significantly this year.

PRIORITY.example: Customer safety is our top priority.
PRIORITY.exampleZh: 顧客安全是我們的首要任務。

ATTRACT.example: The new route has attracted many tourists.
ATTRACT.exampleZh: 這條新路線已經吸引了許多遊客。

INSECT.example: That is the largest insect I have ever seen.
INSECT.exampleZh: 那是我見過最大的昆蟲。

POOL.example: The hotel has a large swimming pool for guests to use.
